item.title: Democratic Party leader 'preferential voting system' to be adopted...'elected youth supreme council member' rejected (민주 당대표 ‘선호투표제’ 도입키로…‘선출직 청년최고위원’은 부결)
item.description:
The supreme council of the Democratic Party of Korea approved a revision to party rules on the 14th, allowing the method of electing the party leader at the August 17 national convention to be a preferential voting system. However, a proposal to separately elect one out of five elected supreme council members as a youth representative was rejected following a vote by the supreme council. (더불어민주당 최고위원회의가 14일 8·17 전당대회 당대표 선출 방식을 선호투표제로 할 수 있게 하는 내용의 당규 개정안을 의결했다. 다만 선출직 최고위원 5명 중 1명을 청년으로 분리 선출하는 내용은 최고위원 표결을 거쳐 부결됐다.)

Senior spokesperson Kang Joon-hyun of the Democratic Party met with reporters after the closed-door supreme council meeting and stated, “We decided to stipulate in the party rules that both the preferential voting system and the runoff voting system can be used as methods for conducting a runoff election,” adding, “The related party rule revision was approved today.” (강준현 민주당 수석대변인은 이날 비공개 최고위 직후 기자들을 만나 “(당규에) 결선투표 실시 방법으로 선호투표제와 결선투표제를 할 수 있음을 명문화하기로 했다”며 “관련 당규 개정의 건을 오늘 의결했다”고 말했다.)

The introduction of an elected youth supreme council member was rejected through a vote by the supreme council. Senior spokesperson Kang further said, “Regarding the method of electing a youth supreme council member, we sought to separate one out of five elected supreme council members to be elected as a youth representative, but the motion was rejected by vote.” (선출직 청년 최고위원 도입은 최고위원 표결을 거쳐 부결됐다. 이어 강 수석대변인은 “청년 최고위원 선출 방법에 대해선 선출직 최고위원 5명 중 1명을 청년 최고위원으로 분리해 선출하고자 했지만 표결에 의해 안건이 부결됐다”고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, Supreme Council Member Lee Sung-yoon resigned from his position on the same day. This is believed to be in protest of the supreme council’s decision, as Lee held the stance that the preferential voting system violates the party constitution and rules. (한편, 이성윤 최고위원은 이날 최고위원직에서 사퇴했다. 이 최고위원은 선호투표제는 당헌·당규 위반이라는 입장으로 이날 최고위 결정에 반발하며 사퇴한 것으로 풀이된다.)

Reporters: Jung Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr, Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr 김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party "Oh Se-hoon also benefited from Myung Tae-kyun...the hammer of justice must fall" (민주 “오세훈도 명태균 수혜자…법의 철퇴 내려져야”)
item.description:
As former President Yoon Suk-yeol was sentenced to two years in prison for receiving free opinion polls from political broker Myung Tae-kyun, the Democratic Party of Korea launched an offensive against Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon, who is on trial for the "Myung Tae-kyun opinion poll payment scandal," calling him "Seoul's Yoon Suk-yeol" and asserting that "the hammer of justice must fall." (정치 브로커 명태균씨에게 여론조사를 무상으로 받은 혐의로 윤석열 전 대통령이 징역 2년을 선고받은 가운데, 더불어민주당이 ‘명태균 여론조사 대납 혐의’로 재판을 받고 있는 오세훈 서울시장을 향해 “서울의 윤석열”이라며 “법의 철퇴가 내려져야 한다”고 공세에 나섰다.)

Democratic Party spokesperson Park Kyung-mi said in a briefing at the National Assembly communication center on the 13th, regarding former President Yoon's guilty verdict, that "justice has prevailed, and we welcome this historic ruling that restores national sovereignty." (박경미 민주당 대변인은 13일 국회 소통관에서 한 브리핑에서 윤 전 대통령 유죄 판결을 두고 “사필귀정, 국민 주권을 바로 세운 역사적 판결을 환영한다”고 밝혔다.)

She added, "Today's conviction makes it clear that the beneficiaries of the Myung Tae-kyun-style opinion polls are not only former President Yoon. There is no reason for the strict standards set by this ruling to be dulled in Mayor Oh Se-hoon's trial. We will closely watch for a consistent and stern judgment from the judiciary until the end." (이어 “오늘 유죄가 확인된 명태균표 여론조사의 수혜자는 윤 전 대통령만이 아니”라며 “이번 판결이 세운 엄정한 잣대가 오세훈 시장 재판에서 무뎌질 이유가 없다. 사법부의 일관되고 준엄한 판단을 끝까지 지켜보겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

Democratic Party lawmaker Park Joo-min also posted on Facebook on the 13th, stating, "There is someone who should take today's ruling seriously," referring to Mayor Oh Se-hoon, who is on trial for allegedly receiving ten opinion polls from Myung Tae-kyun's side and having a long-time supporter pay the costs on his behalf. (박주민 민주당 의원도 13일 페이스북에 글을 올려 “오늘 판결을 무겁게 받아들여야 할 사람이 있다”며 “명태균 쪽의 여론조사를 10차례 제공받고, 그 비용을 오랜 후원자가 대신 내게 했다는 혐의로 재판을 받고 있는 오세훈 시장”이라고 오 시장을 거론했다.)

Democratic Party lawmaker Seo Young-gyo also argued in a Facebook post on the 14th, "Seoul's Yoon Suk-yeol, Oh Se-hoon, must also face the hammer of justice. The court must deliver a stern judgment based solely on the law, evidence, and common sense." (서영교 민주당 의원도 14일 페이스북 글에서 “서울의 윤석열, 오세훈에게도 법의 철퇴가 내려져야 한다”며 “법원은 오직 법과 증거, 그리고 국민 상식에 따른 준엄한 심판을 내려야 한다”고 주장했다.)

Earlier on the 13th, the 33rd Criminal Division of the Seoul Central District Court (Presiding Judge Lee Jin-gwan) sentenced former President Yoon to two years in prison on charges of violating the Political Funds Act. This conclusion stands in stark contrast to the acquittals of First Lady Kim Keon-hee, who was separately indicted for the same criminal facts and found not guilty in both the first and second trials. Former President Yoon had been on trial for conspiring with First Lady Kim, receiving opinion poll results favorable to him from Mr. Myung between April 2021 and March 2022, and in exchange, assisting with nominations for former People Power Party lawmaker Kim Young-sun and others in the 2022 by-elections. (앞서 13일 서울중앙지법 형사33부(재판장 이진관)는 정치자금법 위반 혐의를 받는 윤 전 대통령에게 징역 2년을 선고했다. 동일한 범죄사실로 별도 기소된 김건희 여사가 1·2심에서 모두 무죄를 선고받은 것과는 정반대의 결론이다. 윤 전 대통령은 김 여사와 공모해 2021년 4월~2022년 3월 명씨로부터 윤 전 대통령에게 유리한 여론조사 결과를 제공받고, 그 대가로 2022년 재보궐선거에서 김영선 전 국민의힘 의원 등 공천을 도와준 혐의로 재판을 받아왔다.)

Mayor Oh was also indicted in December last year on charges related to the "Myung Tae-kyun opinion poll payment scandal," and his first trial verdict is scheduled for the 22nd. Mayor Oh is accused of receiving ten opinion poll results from Mr. Myung ahead of the April 7, 2021, Seoul mayoral by-election and having his close associate, former Seoul Deputy Mayor for Political Affairs Kang Chul-won, arrange for supporter and businessman Kim Han-jung to pay 33 million won in costs (violating the Political Funds Act). The special prosecution team led by Min Joong-ki requested a sentence of one year and six months in prison and an additional fine of 33 million won for Mayor Oh during the closing arguments on the 17th of last month. (오 시장도 지난해 12월 ‘명태균 여론조사 대납 혐의’로 기소돼 오는 22일 1심 선고를 앞두고 있다. 오 시장은 2021년 4·7 서울시장 보궐선거를 앞두고 명씨로부터 10차례 여론조사 결과를 받고 측근인 강철원 전 서울시 정무부시장을 통해 후원자인 사업가 김한정씨에게 비용 3300만원을 대납하게 한 혐의(정치자금법 위반)를 받는다. 민중기 특검팀은 지난달 17일 결심공판에서 오 시장에게 징역 1년6개월과 추징금 3300만원을 구형했다.)

Mayor Oh maintains that he never commissioned the opinion polls, reviewed the results, or arranged for the payment of costs. He describes the indictment as "a forced and unreasonable case without a single piece of proper evidence." If a fine of 1 million won or more is finalized in this case, Mayor Oh would have to step down from his mayoral position. (오 시장은 여론조사를 의뢰하거나 결과를 보고받은 적도, 비용을 대납하게 한 적도 없다는 입장이다. “제대로 된 증거가 단 하나도 없는 무리한 짜맞추기 기소”라는 것이다. 이 사건으로 100만원 이상 벌금형이 확정되면 오 시장은 시장직에서 물러나야 한다.)

Jeon Gwang-jun, reporter light@hani.co.kr (전광준 기자 light@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "Mobilize All Efforts for Price and Real Estate Stability… Must Raise Potential Growth Rate to 3%" (이 대통령 “물가·부동산 안정 총력…잠재성장률 3%까지 높여야”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 14th, "We must focus all our efforts on stabilizing prices and real estate, which are directly tied to the people's livelihoods, and gradually raise the potential growth rate to 3% by fostering growth engines with super-gap and super-innovation." (이재명 대통령이 14일 “국민 삶에 직결된 물가와 부동산 안정에 총력을 기울이고, 초격차, 초혁신 성장동력 육성으로 잠재 성장률을 3%까지 단계적으로 높여 나가야 한다”고 말했다.)

President Lee made these remarks during a Cabinet meeting held at the presidential office, Cheong Wa Dae, saying, "In the first half of this year, exports have shown explosive growth, approaching $500 billion." He added, "While semiconductors are leading the growth, this is also the result of a 16% increase in the export of other items compared to last year," and noted, "Amid these remarkable export performances and increases in facility investment, there are growing forecasts that the real growth rate could reach 3% this year." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 “올해 상반기 수출이 5천억불에 육박하는 폭발적인 증가세를 보이고 있다”며 이렇게 말했다. 이 대통령은 “반도체가 성장을 주도하는 가운데, 다른 품목들 수출들도 전년보다 16% 늘어난 결과”라며 “이러한 눈부신 수출 실적과 설비투자 증가를 바탕으로 올해 실질성장률이 3%에 이를 것이란 전망도 잇따르고 있다”고 했다.)

He particularly emphasized a swift push for the "three major mega-projects." President Lee said, "For the early realization of the three major mega-projects, the central government, local governments, and businesses must work together as one. I hope all procedures are carried out as quickly as possible, with the mindset that shortening one day could save ten or even a hundred days later." (특히 ‘3대 메가프로젝트’의 속도전을 강조했다. 이 대통령은 “3대 메가프로젝트 조기 현실화를 위해 중앙정부, 지방정부, 기업이 한몸처럼 열심히 뛰어야겠다. 하루를 단축하면 나중에 열흘, 100일을 벌 수 있다는 자세로 모든 절차를 최대한 빠르게 진행해주길 바란다”고 말했다.)

President Lee continued, "We must also focus on resolving social structural issues," and added, "We need to provide the youth, who are the future of our community, with multi-layered growth ladders in areas such as jobs, housing, assets, and capacity development. At the same time, we must accelerate innovation in reducing labor market disparities, as well as in public sector finances and regulatory areas." (이 대통령은 이어 “사회 구조적 문제를 해소하는 데도 힘을 쏟아야 한다”며 “우리 공동체 미래인 청년들에게 일자리, 주거, 자산 그리고 역량 개발 등에 있어서 다층적인 성장 사다리를 제공하고, 노동시장 격차 완화와 함께 공공기관 재정, 규제 영역에서 혁신도 속도를 내야 한다”고 덧붙였다.)

President Lee stated, "The next 30 years of South Korea's future will be determined by the achievements we make in the second half," and urged, "Let us join forces so that this year can be remembered as the starting point for leaping into an irreplaceable South Korea with a potential growth rate of 3%, a position among the world's top four trading nations, and a national income of $50,000." (이 대통령은 “하반기에 우리가 어떤 성과를 만드느냐에 따라 대한민국 미래 30년이 좌우될 것”이라며 “올해가 잠재성장률 3%, 세계 무역 4강, 국민소득 5만불이라는 대체불가 대한민국으로 도약하는 원년으로 기억될 수 있도록 힘을 모아달라”고 말했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr 심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Song Young-gil: "Jung Cheong-rae Suddenly Brings Up Presidential Election When Administration Has 4 Years Left... Everything Is 'Jung First, Party Later'" (송영길 “정청래, 4년 남은 정권에서 뜬금없이 대선 얘기…모든 게 ‘선청후당’”)
item.description:
Song Young-gil, a lawmaker running in the Democratic Party of Korea's party leadership primary, took direct aim at his competitor, former lawmaker Jung Cheong-rae, on the 14th, stating, "Everything so far has been 'Jung first, party later.'" <<> Appearing on CBS Radio that day, Song said, "During the last presidential election, he thoroughly used it as a pretext for early campaigning for his own party leadership race," and asked rhetorically, "While local elections and by-elections may have had some elements aimed at the party's victory, most of the time they were preparations for his own re-election—didn't he appoint 800 of his close associates as special advisors and run them as candidates for local governments?" He added, "(Former lawmaker Jung) prioritized his own political objectives," and noted, "I believe the party members are assessing it that way." <<> Regarding Jung's declaration the previous day at his campaign press conference that "I will not use the party chairmanship to run for president," Song remarked, "It's already out of place to talk about a presidential election when the current administration still has four years left in its term, and claiming you won't use party power to run for president is a strange and sudden statement." He added, "Who asked you to run?" <<> Song said, "It is unprecedented in constitutional history for the media's main focus to be on a 'power struggle between the president and the party leader' during the first year of the president's term." He then added, "We need a ruling party leader who can join forces with the president to upgrade the nation and create an 'irreplaceable Republic of Korea,'" asserting that he is the right person for the job. <<> Reporter Ko Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (더불어민주당 당 대표 경선에 출마한 송영길 의원이 14일 경쟁자인 정청래 전 대표를 겨냥해 “그동안 모든 게 선청후당(정청래가 먼저, 당이 나중)이었다”고 직격했다.)

item.title: In a Cabinet Meeting, a Surprise Vote on 'Ultra-High-Priced Single Home'... President Lee Says "Unexpected" as Public Opinion Favors 'Over 3 Billion Won' (국무회의서 ‘초고가 1주택' 깜짝 투표…‘30억 이상’ 여론에 이 대통령 “의외네”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung conducted an impromptu vote via comments during a live-streamed Cabinet meeting on the 14th, asking whether a burden should be imposed on the ownership tax for ultra-high-priced single homes. (이재명 대통령이 14일 생중계 국무회의에서 초고가 1주택 보유세 부담 여부를 댓글로 묻는 즉석 투표를 진행했다.)

At the Cabinet meeting held at the Blue House that day, President Lee made an on-the-spot suggestion: "For a single home that is actually lived in, but if it's an ultra-high-priced property, please write 1 in the comments if you agree with imposing an additional ownership burden beyond the usual protection, or 2 if not." He then observed the comments appearing on the live broadcast of the Cabinet meeting for one minute. Director of the Office for Government Policy Coordination, Im Ki-geun, reported, "About 90% of the opinions were in favor of the additional burden, and about 10% were against." President Lee said, "We will proceed like this at the (real estate grand debate) as well," adding, "As for how much the threshold should be for imposing the additional burden—20, 30, or 40 million won—I wonder if you could press the first digit." When Director Im noted, "Public opinion most favors 30 million won," President Lee replied, "Unexpected. I thought it would be 50 million won." <<> When Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom said, "20 million won also has quite a bit of support," President Lee commented, "If we go with that, we might be in big trouble." Prime Minister Han Seong-sook responded with a smile, "I have nothing to say," to which President Lee asked, "Is it over 20 million won? You don't own a house, do you? Not anymore." Prime Minister Han said, "I do have one house. But it's worth over 20 million won." <<> From this day until the 16th, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, the Financial Services Commission, and the Ministry of Economy and Finance will each hold public forums on the topics of supply, finance, and taxation, respectively, to hear opinions from experts and the public. Afterwards, a grand debate attended by President Lee will be held on the 23rd. <<> Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon, who was elected in the June 3 local elections, attended his first Cabinet meeting this day and requested to speak. When Mayor Oh asked, "Prime Minister, may I say a word?" Prime Minister Han replied, "Since there is a public grand debate, it would be better to defer. Please submit what you have in writing." <<> Mayor Oh stated, "I have delivered the report prepared by the Seoul Metropolitan Government to the Policy Chief, the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, and the Deputy Prime Minister for the Economy," and added, "Since I won't be given an opportunity to speak, I will substitute it with the contents of the report." President Lee then remarked, "Please also report on how the reconstruction and redevelopment in Seoul is progressing and why there are assessments that the supply volume is insufficient." <<> On this day, the relevant real estate ministries summarized the issues to be covered in the real estate grand debate. Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy and Finance Koo Yun-cheol said at the Cabinet meeting, "We will operate the real estate tax system not to stabilize housing prices but to improve distortions and irrationalities in the real estate market." The issues identified by the Ministry of Economy and Finance include 11 items: △Differentiation of real estate tax burdens by region △Phased implementation of real estate tax reform △Appropriate level of property tax and comprehensive real estate holding tax △Reform of the comprehensive real estate tax system △Use of comprehensive real estate tax revenue △Reform of the special deduction for long-term holding △Necessity of maintaining the heavy taxation system for multi-homeowners △Need for tax special provisions for the elderly, long-term residents, and relocation to provinces △Necessity of reducing capital gains tax in line with property tax increases △Whether to lower acquisition taxes for ordinary and middle-class households and the need to overhaul the heavy taxation system for multi-homeowners. <<> The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport reported seven issues related to housing supply: △Deregulation to revitalize private redevelopment and reconstruction △Utilization of idle sites in urban centers such as the Yongsan International Business District △Easing financial and tax regulations for multi-homeowners to supply new non-apartment housing △Flexibilization of urban and building regulations △Private rental housing suppliers (to supply rental housing jointly with the public sector) △The proportion of public rental and public sale housing supply. <<> The Financial Services Commission identified three issues: △Need to adjust loan regulations and expand policy loans to support genuine demanders such as youth △Direction of regulatory policy on jeonse (lump-sum deposit) loans △Regulations on relocation loans. <<> Reporter Seo Young-ji: yj@hani.co.kr (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 “실거주 1주택인데, 초고가 주택에 대해선 통상적인 보호보다는 추가 보유 부담을 하는 데 동의하면 item.title: President Lee: "Lowering the age of juvenile offenders by one year is insufficient... I will not make a final decision today." (이 대통령 “촉법소년 1살 낮추는 건 미약…오늘 최종 결정 안 하겠다”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 14th regarding ongoing discussions about lowering the age of criminal minors (juvenile offenders) from under 14 to under 13 years old, specifically for violent, serious, and repeat offenses, "It seems we do need to lower it," and "I hear it's about lowering it by one year for certain crimes, but I think that might be too insufficient." (이재명 대통령이 14일 형사미성년자(촉법소년) 연령 기준을 강력·중대·반복 범죄에 한해 만 14살 미만에서 13살 미만으로 하향하자는 논의가 이뤄지고 있는 것과 관련 “낮추긴 낮춰야 할 것 같다”, “특정범죄에 대해선 1살 낮추자는 거 같은데 그건 너무 미약하지 않냐는 생각이 든다”고 말했다.)

President Lee made these remarks during a cabinet meeting held at the Blue House, after receiving a report from the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family on public discussions about the age criteria for criminal minors. (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 성평등가족부의 형사미성년자 연령 기준 공론화와 관련한 보고를 들은 뒤 이렇게 말했다.)

President Lee added, "I've seen scenes where (offenders) commit crimes while saying, 'I won't be punished.'" He continued, "Looking at that, isn't one year too short? For example, a 12-year-old could commit murder or a serious crime." He further noted, "Globally, there are quite a few cases where the age (of juvenile offenders) is set at 12, aren't there?" (이 대통령은 “‘나 처벌 안 받아’라고 하면서 (범죄를) 저지르는 장면도 있더라”며 “그런 걸 보면, 1살만으로 부족하지 않냐. 예를 들어 12살인데 살해나 중범죄를 저지를 수도 있지 않느냐”라고 말했다. 이 대통령은 이어 “전 세계적으로 (촉법소년 연령을) 12살로 하는 경우도 꽤 많지 않냐”고 덧붙였다.)

When President Lee asked, "I heard many experts were opposed to lowering the age of juvenile offenders at all, preferring to maintain the status quo," Minister Won Min-kyung of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family responded, "It seems the public often misunderstands 'juvenile offenders' as not being punished, but in reality, long-term detention for up to two years at a juvenile detention center is possible, and serious measures follow. People just weren't aware." (이 대통령이 이어 “전문가들은 촉법소년 연령을 아예 안 낮추고, 현상 유지하는 의견이 많았다고 하던데”라고 묻자 원민경 성평등가족부 장관은 “국민들은 촉법소년이라고 하면, 처벌을 안 받는 것으로 많이 오해하는 거 같은데 사실상 소년원 2년간 장기 송치 처분이 가능하고 중대한 처분이 뒤따른다는 걸 잘 몰랐던 거 같다”고 답했다.)

However, Minister of Justice Jung Sung-ho pointed out, "For juvenile offenders, no criminal record remains, so it doesn't pose any obstacle when entering public office." At this, President Lee made a pointed joke, saying, "So that's why the story about Lee Jae-myung's juvenile detention center comes up." During the presidential election, false news had circulated that President Lee had been in a juvenile detention center. (다만 정성호 법무부 장관은 “소년범의 경우 전과가 남지 않아 공직에 갈 때 아무런 장애가 되지 않는다”고 말했다. 그러자 이 대통령은 “그래서 이재명 소년원 얘기가 나오는구나”라고 뼈 있는 농담을 하기도 했다. 대선 당시 이 대통령이 소년원 출신이라는 가짜뉴스가 돌기도 했다.)

President Lee stated, "This is a difficult topic. Let's not make a final decision today, but gather more opinions from our citizens." He added, "The question remains whether we'll lower it by one year or two years. It does seem we need to lower it. Let's discuss whether to lower it partially or fully, and whether to apply it to all crimes. In the meantime, let's collect public opinions." (이 대통령은 “어려운 주제인데, 오늘 최종결정을 하지 말고, 우리 국민들 의견을 더 수렴해보자”며 “한 살 또는 두 살을 낮출 거냐 이게 남는 건데, 낮추긴 낮춰야 할 것 같다. 부분적으로 낮출 건지, 전면적으로 낮출 건지, 모든 범죄에 낮출 건지 이 범위 내에서 토론을 한 번 해보고 그 사이에 국민 의견을 수렴해보자”고 말했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr 심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Photo] How long has it been?…Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon attends a State Council meeting ([포토] 이게 얼마 만?…국무회의 참석한 오세훈 서울시장)
item.description:
Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon attended a State Council meeting presided over by President Lee Jae-myung at the presidential office Yongsan on the 14th. It was his first attendance at a State Council meeting in 11 months since August of last year, and his first after being elected to a fifth term as Seoul Mayor in the June 3 local elections. (오세훈 서울시장이 14일 청와대에서 열린 이재명 대통령 주재 국무회의에 참석했다. 오 시장의 국무회의 참석은 지난해 8월 이후 11개월 만이며 6·3 지방선거에서 5선 서울시장으로 당선된 뒤 처음이다.)

On this day, after the Ministry of Economy and Finance, Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, and Financial Services Commission reported on the "Plan for Gathering Public Opinions on Real Estate Policies," Mayor Oh requested to speak. However, Prime Minister Han Sung-sook, who was moderating the discussion, mentioned the schedule for the National Grand Debate and said, "Since there is a grand debate on this matter, it would be better to defer the discussion to that forum. Please submit your input in writing instead of an oral statement. We will accept this item as originally proposed." (이날 오 시장은 ‘부동산 정책 관련 국민 의견 수렴 계획’에 대한 재정경제부와 국토교통부·금융위원회의 보고가 끝나자, 발언을 신청했지만 토론 진행을 맡은 한성숙 국무총리는 국민 대토론회 일정을 언급하며 “이 건은 대토론회가 있으니 그쪽으로 넘겨 논의하는 것이 좋겠다”며 “시장님이 주실 것은 구두 발언 대신 서류로 받도록 하겠다. 이 부분은 원안대로 접수하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Earlier, Mayor Oh had announced that he would attend the State Council meeting to make public suggestions regarding real estate policies. (앞서 오 시장은 국무회의에 참석해 부동산 정책 관련 공개 건의를 하겠다고 예고한 바 있다.)

item.title: President Lee: “If reforms are loud, they may look cool but lead to stronger resistance…Hard to achieve results” (이 대통령 “개혁, 요란하면 멋있어도 저항 강해져…성과내기 어렵다”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 14th regarding reforms, “If you shout a lot and make a big commotion, it might look cool, but doing so increases the intensity of resistance and makes it hard to achieve results.” (이재명 대통령이 14일 개혁과 관련해 “소리를 많이 지르고, 요란하게 하면 멋있을지는 몰라도 그렇게 하면 저항 강도가 세지고 성과를 내기가 어렵다”고 말했다.)

At a Cabinet meeting held at the Presidential Office that day, President Lee stated, “Recently, regarding reforms, there seems to be talk that the Lee Jae-myung administration only talks about growth and the economy. Some wonder if we are neglecting reforms or turning our backs on welfare,” adding the above remarks. (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 “최근 개혁과 관련해 이재명 정부가 너무 성장과 경제 얘기만 한다. 개혁을 소홀히 하는 거 아니냐. 복지를 외면하는 거 아니냐는 얘기를 하는 거 같다”며 이같이 말했다.)

President Lee further said, “That is an area of government determination. Welfare policies are being expanded as much as needed. If necessary, welfare-related departments should just steadily move forward as originally planned. The intensity of resistance is high, and the amount of cheers generated by the results of reforms is inevitably small. That’s why social reform is difficult.” (이어 이 대통령은 “그건 정부의 결단의 영역”이라며 “복지 정책은 필요한 만큼 계속 확장해가고 있다. 필요하면 복지 관련 부서들은 우리가 원래 계획대로 뚜벅뚜벅 가면 된다. 저항의 강도는 크고, 개혁의 성과에 따라서는 생기는 환호의 양은 적고 그럴 수밖에 없다. 그래서 사회개혁은 어렵다”고 덧붙였다.)

President Lee also commented on specific methods of reform. He said, “Does shouting loudly, speaking harshly, and making aggressive gestures lead to success? It might feel good, but the results are unlikely to be good. That’s why reform is more difficult than revolution.” (이 대통령은 개혁의 구체적 방법에 대해서도 언급했다. 이 대통령은 “목소리 크고, 세게 얘기하고 삿대질을 하면 잘 되냐. 뭐 기분은 좋을지 몰라도 결과는 좋기 어렵다”며 “그래서 혁명보다 개혁이 더 어렵다”고 말했다.)

President Lee’s remarks draw attention as they come amid disagreements within the Democratic Party of Korea over issues such as the abolition of the prosecution’s supplementary investigation authority related to prosecution reform. President Lee stated, “We need to persuade, gain broad public consensus on the legitimacy, and proceed step by step and effectively, so that ‘someday it has changed.’ The process of building consensus is difficult and can take time. There are cases where people think of pragmatism as the opposite of reform, but that’s not the case.” (이 대통령의 발언은 더불어민주당 내 검찰 보완수사권 폐지 여부 등 검찰개혁을 둘러싼 이견이 제기된 가운데 나와 주목된다. 이 대통령은 “설득하고, 정당성에 대해 많은 사람들의 공감을 얻고 순차적으로 실효적으로 해서 ‘어느 순간 바뀌었네’ 이렇게 해야 한다”며 “공감하는 과정이 어렵고, 시간이 걸리기도 한다. 우리가 실용이 마치 개혁의 반대말처럼 생각하는 경우들이 있는데 그런 게 아니다”라고 말했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr 심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee Tells Mayor Oh Se-hoon, “Report Why Reconstruction and Redevelopment Are Delayed” (이 대통령, 오세훈 시장에 “재건축·재개발 지연 이유 보고해달라”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung told Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon, who attended the Cabinet meeting on the 14th, “Congratulations on your election,” and added, “Please report why reconstruction and redevelopment are being delayed, along with the reasons and countermeasures.” (이재명 대통령이 14일 국무회의에 참석한 오세훈 서울시장에게 “당선 축하한다”며 “재건축·재개발이 왜 지연되는지, 그 이유와 대책을 보고해달라”고 말했다.)

President Lee gave Mayor Oh a chance to speak at the end of the Cabinet meeting he chaired at the presidential office that day. Mayor Oh began, “I will do my utmost to improve the quality of life for Seoul citizens. What’s a bit disappointing is that although several meetings on real estate measures have been prepared, aside from that, here at the Cabinet meeting with fellow ministers, regarding Seoul’s housing administration…” At that point, President Lee interrupted him, saying, “Let’s talk about that later.” Mayor Oh then said, “The report I prepared contains some uncomfortable points. Since it’s been drafted as discussion material, I hope you will read it and ensure various opinions are adopted in a balanced way. Thank you very much for giving me this opportunity to speak.” <<> Earlier, during the early part of the Cabinet meeting, while there was a briefing and discussion on the topic of “Plan for Collecting Public Opinions on Real Estate Policy,” Mayor Oh requested to speak, asking, “Prime Minister, may I say something?” But Prime Minister Han Seong-sook replied, “A public debate is scheduled on this matter. I will receive your opinions in written form,” denying him the opportunity to speak. <<> In response, Mayor Oh said, “I have already forwarded the report prepared by the Seoul Metropolitan Government to the Policy Office Director, the Minister of Land, Infrastructure, and Transport, and the Deputy Prime Minister for the Economy. Since it seems I won’t be given a chance to speak, I will substitute with the contents of the report.” Then President Lee said, “Please also report on how Seoul’s reconstruction and redevelopment are progressing and why there are assessments that the supply volume is insufficient.” <<> By Seo Young-ji, Reporter yj@hani.co.kr (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의 막바지에 오 시장에게 발언 기회를 줬다. 오 시장은 “서울시민의 삶의 질 향상을 위해 최선의 노력을 다하겠다. 조금 아쉬운 것은 부동산 관련 대책 회의가 여러 차례 준비돼 있지만, 그것과 무관하게 국무회의에서 여러 국무위원 모시고 서울시의 주택 행정 관련…”이라고 발언하는 과정에서 이 대통령이 말을 끊었다. 이 대통령은 “그 얘기는 나중에 하시죠”라고 말했다. 그러자 오 시장은 “준비한 보고서에 불편한 내용도 있다”며 “토론자료로 작성된 것인 만큼 일독하셔서 다양한 의견이 균형 있게 채택되면 좋겠다. 말씀드릴 기회를 주셔서 정말 감사드린다”고 말했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Leaving Abortion Pill Unregulated is Irresponsible... Could Also Leave It to Doctors' Discretion" (이 대통령 “임신중단약 도입 방치 무책임…의사에 맡기는 방법도”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 14th regarding the issue of introducing the abortion pill (Mifepristone) domestically that "it is irresponsible for the government to continue neglecting this matter" and instructed relevant ministries to come up with practical solutions. (이재명 대통령이 14일 임신중단약(미프진) 국내 도입 문제와 관련해 “정부가 지금처럼 방치하는 것은 무책임하다”며 관련 부처에 실용적인 해결 방안을 마련하라고 지시했다.)

During a Cabinet meeting held at the Blue House that day, President Lee said, "It seems that since it is not permitted here, women are buying it through overseas direct purchases, but because women who actually need it are purchasing and taking it directly from abroad, accidents are occurring," adding, "Even if there are difficulties for the government, shouldn't we enable them to take it properly?" (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 열린 국무회의에서 “우리는 허용이 안 돼 여성들이 해외 직구를 통해 복용하는 것 같은데, 현실적으로 필요한 여성들이 해외에서 직접 구매해 복용하다 보니 사고도 난다”며 “정부에 어려움이 있더라도 적정하게 투약할 수 있게 해야 하는 것 아니냐”고 말했다.)

Pointing out that the issue of allowing the abortion pill is tied up with legislative discussions on the scope of abortion permissions, President Lee said, "If we try to resolve all the fundamental issues at once, we won't be able to do anything. If we keep debating this, we might not reach a conclusion until the end of my term." He added, "In principle, it is right to set a period for allowing abortion and have doctors prescribe within that period," but stressed, "In reality, women who need it are buying and taking the drug from abroad without any oversight, and this leaves the government shirking responsibility while only the people are placed in danger, abandoned outside the law." <<> President Lee also indicated that utilizing doctors' discretion could be considered. He said, "Even before alternative legislation is prepared, there might be a way to let doctors decide whether to prescribe at their own discretion." He added, "Even if it's imperfect, wouldn't it be better than leaving things unattended?" <<> President Lee ordered Prime Minister Han Sung-sook to coordinate with relevant ministries, saying, "I hope we can come up with a solution through a compromise approach. This doesn't seem like something we can just let slide." <<> Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (이 대통령은 임신중단약 허용이 낙태 허용 범위와 관련한 입법 논의에 묶여 있는 상황을 지적하며 “원론적인 문제까지 다 해결하려고 하다 보면 아무것도 못 한다”며 “이 문제를 논의하다가는 임기 끝날 때까지 결론을 못 낼 수도 있다”고 말했다. 그러면서 이 대통령은 “원칙적으로는 낙태 허용 기간을 정하고 그 기간 안에서 의사가 처방하도록 하는 것이 맞다”면서도 “현실적으로 필요한 여성들은 아무런 관리 없이 해외에서 약을 구입해 복용하는 상황인데, 법 밖에 방치된 채 정부는 책임을 피하고 국민만 위험에 빠지는 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Following North Korea’s Premier’s Visit to China, Wang Huning, China’s Fourth-Highest Ranking Official, to Visit North Korea from 15th to 17th (북 총리 방중 이어 ‘중국 서열 4위’ 왕후닝 15∼17일 방북)

item.title: Election Commission Doles Out 17.5 Billion Won in Contracts to Former Officials and Family Companies... Also Supplies Semi-Transparent Advance Voting Boxes (선관위, 전관·가족회사에 175억 일감 몰아줘…반투명 사전투표함도 납품)
item.description:
Companies whose representatives or executives include former high-ranking officials of the National Election Commission (NEC) and their family members have been found to have signed contracts with the commission totaling over 17.5 billion won. (선거관리위원회 전직 간부와 그 가족이 대표를 맡거나 임원으로 참여한 업체들이 선관위와 체결한 계약 규모가 175억원을 넘는 것으로 나타났다.)

According to data submitted by the NEC and others on the 14th to Rep. Joo Jin-woo of the People Power Party, a member of the National Assembly’s Special Committee for the Parliamentary Investigation into the Shortage of Ballot Papers for the June 3 Local Elections (the special investigation committee), three companies linked to a former senior official of the National Election Commission, referred to as Mr. A, and his family signed a total of 103 contracts with the NEC, amounting to 17.55323 billion won. Of these, 90 contracts were awarded through private negotiation. (국회 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 국정조사특별위원회(국조특위) 소속 주진우 국민의힘 의원이 14일 선관위 등으로부터 제출받은 자료를 보면, 중앙선관위 출신의 ㄱ씨와 그 가족이 관련된 3개 업체가 선관위와 체결한 계약은 총 103건으로 175억5323만원 규모에 달하는 것으로 나타났다. 이 가운데 90건이 수의계약이었다.)

Specifically, Company B, of which Mr. A serves as CEO, has just three employees and signed a total of 66 contracts (worth 2.9752 billion won) with the NEC, with 64 of them being private contracts. This company also supplied the semi-transparent in-district advance voting boxes that sparked controversy during the recent June 3 local elections. (구체적으로는 ㄱ씨가 대표이사로 있는 ㄴ업체가 직원 3명을 두고 선관위와 총 66건(29억 7520만원 규모)의 계약을 체결했고 이 가운데 64건이 수의계약이었다. 이 업체는 이번 6·3 지방선거에서 논란이 된 반투명 관내 사전투표함을 납품하기도 했다.)

Company C, represented by Mr. A’s spouse, signed a total of nine contracts with the NEC worth 490.45 million won, eight of which were private contracts. Companies B and C were located on the same floor of the same building, and Mr. A was once registered as an auditor for Company C. (ㄱ씨의 배우자가 대표인 ㄷ업체는 선관위와 총 9건, 4억945만원의 계약을 체결했다. 이 가운데 8건이 수의계약이었다. ㄴ업체와 ㄷ업체는 같은 건물·같은 층에 있었고, ㄱ씨는 이 회사의 감사로 등기된 이력이 있다.)

Company D, where Mr. A served as an internal director, also signed a total of 28 contracts with the NEC worth 14.16858 billion won. Among these, 18 contracts (valued at 4.34808 billion won) were awarded through private negotiation. (ㄱ씨가 사내이사로 참여했던 ㄹ업체도 선관위와 총 28건, 141억6858만원의 계약을 체결했다. 이 중 18건(43억4808만원 규모)은 수의계약이다.)

At the hearing of the special investigation committee on the same day, Rep. Joo Jin-woo stated, “The NEC is not even a family-owned company, yet this is how the NEC cartel operates, making a special counsel investigation inevitable.” Acting NEC Chairman Wi Cheol-hwan responded, “We will thoroughly reform and correct this,” adding, “We will mobilize all means to ensure that former public officials are not involved in any form of contract arrangements.” (주진우 의원은 이날 국조특위 청문회에서 “선관위가 가족회사도 아니고 이런 식으로 선관위 카르텔이 작동하니까 특검이 불가피하다”고 말했다. 위철환 중앙선관위원장 직무대행은 “철저하게 개혁해서 시정하겠다”며 “전직 공무원들은 어떤 형식이든지 계약에 관여하지 않도록 모든 방법을 동원하겠다”고 답했다.)

Reporter Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (김해정 기자 sea@hani.co.kr 유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Hong Joon-pyo: "Oh Se-hoon Will Find It Hard to Escape the Myung Tae-kyun Case... Judge Lee Jin-gwan Was Accurate" (홍준표 “오세훈, 명태균 사건 빠져나가기 어려워…이진관 판사 정확”)
item.description:
After former President Yoon Suk-yeol received a prison sentence in the first trial for receiving free polling results from political broker Myung Tae-kyun, former Daegu Mayor Hong Joon-pyo stated, "Judge Lee Jin-gwan was accurate in his judgment," and added, "Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon will likely find it hard to escape." (윤석열 전 대통령이 정치브로커 명태균씨로부터 무상 여론조사 결과를 받은 혐의로 1심에서 실형을 선고받자 홍준표 전 대구시장이 “이진관 판사는 정확히 (판결)했다”며 “오세훈 서울시장이 빠져나가기 어렵지 않을까”라고 말했다.)

In an interview with CBS Radio's "Park Jae-hong's One-Round Match" on the 13th, former Mayor Hong said regarding the sentencing of former President Yoon to two years in prison and the court detention of Mr. Myung that day, "I think it was an accurate judgment." He also commented on the earlier acquittal of First Lady Kim Keon-hee in the first and second trials for the same criminal charges, calling it "nonsense." (홍 전 시장은 13일 시비에스(CBS) 라디오 ‘박재홍의 한판승부’와의 인터뷰에서 이날 윤 전 대통령에게 징역 2년이 선고되고 명씨가 법정구속된 데 대해 “정확한 판단이라고 본다”고 말했다. 또 앞서 김건희 여사가 같은 범죄 사실로 기소돼 1·2심에서 무죄를 선고받은 데 대해선 “그게 엉터리였다”고 말했다.)

On that day, Criminal Division 33 of the Seoul Central District Court (Presiding Judge Lee Jin-gwan) sentenced former President Yoon to two years in prison and a fine of approximately 13.96 million won, and Mr. Myung to one year and six months in prison on charges of violating the Political Funds Act. Mr. Myung was detained in court due to concerns over evidence tampering. (이날 서울중앙지법 형사33부(재판장 이진관)는 정치자금법 위반 혐의로 기소된 윤 전 대통령에게 징역 2년에 추징금 약 1396만원을, 명씨에게 징역 1년6개월을 선고했다. 명씨는 ‘증거인멸 우려’로 이날 법정에서 구속됐다.)

In response to the host's remark that "some say that, in light of today's ruling, the chances of Mayor Oh's case resulting in a conviction seem higher," former Mayor Hong said, "Mayor Oh will find it hard to escape the Myung Tae-kyun case." He added, "I know the background of how Oh Se-hoon and Myung Tae-kyun came to meet when that case broke out," and "I heard a lot about Mr. Myung being a poll manipulation fraud from the time I was governor of South Gyeongsang Province." (홍 전 시장은 “오늘 판결을 보면서 오 시장 사건도 유죄가 될 확률이 높아 보인다는 분도 있다”는 진행자의 말에 “명태균 사건에 오 시장이 빠져나가기가 어렵지 않을까”라고 말했다. 홍 전 시장은 “그 사건 터졌을 때부터 오세훈, 명태균이 만나게 된 계기를 내가 안다”며 “(명씨가) 여론 조작 사기꾼이라는 거를 경남지사 할 때부터 이야기를 많이 들었다”고도 했다.)

Earlier, the special investigation team led by Min Joong-ki indicted Mayor Oh in December last year on charges of violating the Political Funds Act. This stemmed from allegations that, ahead of the April 2021 Seoul mayoral by-election, Mayor Oh received polling results from Mr. Myung on ten occasions and arranged for his aide, former Seoul Deputy Mayor for Political Affairs Kang Chul-won, to have businessman and supporter Kim Han-jung pay 33 million won in costs. The special team requested on the 17th of last month that the court sentence Mayor Oh to one year and six months in prison and a 33 million won fine. The first trial verdict is scheduled for the 22nd. <<> Regarding First Lady Kim, who was acquitted in the first and second trials, the Supreme Court is expected to deliver its ruling on the 16th. <<> Reporter Song Kyung-hwa freehwa@hani.co.kr (앞서 민중기 특검팀은 2021년 4월 서울시장 보궐선거를 앞두고 명씨로부터 10차례 여론조사 결과를 받고 측근인 강철원 전 서울시 정무부시장을 통해 후원자인 사업가 김한정씨에게 비용 3300만원을 대납하게 한 혐의(정치자금법 위반)로 지난해 12월 오 시장을 기소했다. 특검팀은 오 시장에게 징역 1년6개월과 추징금 3300만원을 선고해달라고 지난달 17일 재판부에 요청한 상태다. 1심 선고는 오는 22일 열린다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae "I'm the Right Person to Unite the Core"… Song Young-gil "Jeong First, Party Second; In the Old Days, That Would Be Treason" (정청래 “내가 코어 묶을 적임자”…송영길 “선청후당, 옛날이면 역적”)
item.description:
The day after former lawmaker Jung Cheong-rae declared his candidacy for party leader, the war of nerves among the 'Big Three' candidates for the Democratic Party of Korea's August 17 national convention intensified further. Former Representative Jung emphasized that day that he was "the right person to unite the party's core support base." Former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and lawmaker Song Young-gil, responding to Jeong's earlier statement that he "would not run for president," sharpened their attacks, calling it "out of nowhere" and "Jeong first, party second," respectively. (전날 정청래 전 대표가 당 대표 출마 선언을 하며 14일 더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 ‘빅3’ 후보들 사이의 신경전은 한층 더 가열됐다. 정 전 대표는 이날 자신이 “당 핵심 지지층을 한군데 묶어 세울 적임자”라고 강조했다. 김민석 전 총리와 송영길 의원은 전날 “대선 출마 안 한다”고 한 정 전 대표를 향해 각각 “뜬금없다”, “선청후당(정청래가 먼저, 당이 나중)”이라고 날을 세웠다.)

Appearing on the YouTube show 'Kim Eo-jun's Humility is Hard News Factory' that day, former Representative Jung said, "To unite and organize the traditional core support base, someone has to play that role. The right person is Jung Cheong-rae." Regarding his previous declaration that he "would not use the party leadership position to run for president," he explained, "I thought, 'They might attack me saying, 'This is a buildup to the presidential election', so I decided to block it." (정 전 대표는 이날 유튜브 방송 ‘김어준의 겸손은힘들다 뉴스공장’에 나와 “전통적 핵심, 코어 지지층을 한 군데로 묶어 세우려면 누군가는 역할을 해야 한다. 적임자는 정청래”라고 했다. 전날 출마 선언에서 “당 대표직을 이용해 대선에 출마하지 않겠다”고 한 것에 대해서 그는 “‘대선 빌드업이지’ 이런 공격이 들어올 거 같아 차단해야겠다고 생각했다”고 설명했다.)

In contrast, former Prime Minister Kim, appearing on the YouTube show 'Genre is Yeouido' that day, targeted former Representative Jung, saying, "Who is thinking about the presidential election right now? It's extremely out of nowhere." He argued, "The reason party-government relations have been poor over the past year is because of the party leader's personal politics," and emphasized, "The next party leader's only concerns should be supporting state affairs and winning the general election," asserting himself as the right person for the job. (반면 김 전 총리는 이날 유튜브 방송 ‘장르만 여의도’에 출연해 정 전 대표를 겨냥해 “지금 누가 대선에 관심이 있나. 굉장히 뜬금없다”고 말했다. 그는 “지난 1년간 당정 관계가 잘 안 된 것은 당대표의 자기 정치 때문”이라며 “다음 (당) 대표는 제일 관심사가 국정 지원하고 총선 승리밖에는 없다”고 자신이 당 대표 적임자라고 강조했다.)

Lawmaker Song also appeared on CBS Radio's 'Park Seong-tae's News Show' that day and directly criticized former Representative Jung, saying, "Everything so far has been 'Jeong first, party second.'" Later that afternoon, at a meeting of the National Honam Regional Association held in Yongsan-gu, Seoul, he said, "Every time, absurd incidents occur where 'Myeong-Jeong (Lee Jae-myung - Jeong Cheong-rae) showdown' graces the front pages of newspapers. This is unacceptable," and added, "In the old days, this would be a situation where you'd be executed for treason." (송 의원도 이날 시비에스(CBS) 라디오 ‘박성태의 뉴스쇼’에 나와 정 전 대표를 겨냥해 “그동안 모든 게 ‘선청후당’이었다”고 직격했다. 그는 이날 오후 서울 용산구에서 열린 전국호남향우회 총연합회 간담회 자리에서 “매번 신문에 ‘명청(이재명-정청래) 대전’으로 1면을 장식하는 어이없는 일이 벌어지고 있다. 있을 수 없는 일”이라며 “옛날 같으면 역적으로 목을 잘라 진압을 해야 할 상황”이라고도 했다.)

Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee's House Sold for 2.9 Billion Won... "Main Contract Within Days" (이 대통령 집, 29억에 팔렸다…“수일 내 본계약”)
item.description:
The procedure for disposing of the apartment jointly owned by President Lee Jae-myung and his wife in Bundang-gu, Seongnam-si, Gyeonggi Province, is expected to be completed shortly. (이재명 대통령 부부가 공동 소유한 경기 성남시 분당구 아파트 처분 절차가 조만간 마무리된다.)

The presidential office announced on the 14th that, regarding the apartment in Bundang-gu put up for sale by President Lee and his wife in February, "The main contract will be signed within a few days." According to the presidential office, although a prospective buyer appeared shortly after the property was listed and a preliminary contract was signed, it took time to finalize the main contract due to related administrative procedures such as land transaction permits. The price of the apartment put up by President Lee and his wife is 2.9 billion won, which is relatively low compared to the asking prices of similar-sized apartments. (청와대는 14일 이 대통령 부부가 지난 2월 매물로 내놓은 분당구 아파트와 관련해 “수일 내 본계약을 체결한다”고 밝혔다. 매물을 내놓은 지 얼마 안돼 매수 희망자가 나타나 가계약을 체결했지만, 토지거래허가 등 관련 행정절차로 본계약까지 시간이 소요됐다는 게 청와대 설명이다. 이 대통령 부부가 내놓은 아파트 가격은 29억원으로 같은 평수의 아파트 호가에 견줘 저렴한 편이다.)

In a post on X (formerly Twitter) in February, President Lee stated, "I moved from one rented house to another and bought this house for the first and last time in my life during the IMF (referring to the foreign exchange crisis period). It is a house where I spent my youth raising my children, so I have several times more affection for it than money." He added, "As the person responsible for real estate policy, I sold it to set an example for everyone rather than providing material for political attacks concerning housing issues." (이 대통령은 지난 2월 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 올린 글에서 “셋방살이 전전하다 아이엠에프(IMF·외환위기 시기를 뜻함)때 평생 처음이자 마지막으로 산 집이다. 아이들 키워내며 젊은 시절을 보낸 집이라 돈보다도 몇 배나 애착 있는 집”이라며 “부동산 정책 총책임자로서 집 문제를 가지고 정치적 공격 거리를 만들어 주는 것보다 만인의 모범이 되기 위해 팔았다”고 밝혔다.)

item.title: US Ambassador Kang Kyung-wha Makes Rare Return to Korea: Likely to Discuss Coupang, Network Act, Warship Construction (강경화 주미대사 이례적 귀국…쿠팡·정통망법·군함 건조 논의할 듯)
item.description:
Amid a pile-up of security, economic, and trade issues between South Korea and the United States, Ambassador to the US Kang Kyung-wha plans to temporarily return to Korea to discuss a wide range of matters with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and other government agencies. (한-미 간 안보·경제·통상 현안이 산적한 가운데, 강경화 주미대사가 일시 귀국해 외교부를 비롯한 정부 부처와 사안 전반을 논의할 계획이다.)

Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Park Il said at a regular briefing on the 14th that Ambassador Kang "will temporarily return to Korea from the 15th to the 19th under the instruction of Foreign Minister Cho Hyun to hold working-level consultations on overall South Korea-US relations, including with relevant agencies. The main purpose is to listen to the ambassador's suggestions or candid opinions on ways to develop bilateral relations." (박일 외교부 대변인은 14일 정례브리핑에서 강 대사가 “조현 외교부 장관 지시에 따라 15∼19일간 일시 귀국해 한-미 관계 전반에 대해 유관 부처들을 포함해 업무 협의를 할 예정”이라며 “양국 관계 발전 방안에 대한 공관장의 건의나 솔직한 의견을 청취하는 것이 주요 목적”이라고 말했다.)

It is unusual for an ambassador dealing with the US government and Congress on the ground to return to Korea to discuss pending issues. This move is seen against the backdrop of sluggish progress in security negotiations, US investment, and shipbuilding cooperation agreed upon by the South Korea-US summit in November 2025, as well as heightened tensions with the US over the Coupang incident and the implementation of the Information and Communications Network Act. Negotiations on expanding rights for uranium enrichment and spent nuclear fuel reprocessing, as well as nuclear submarine construction, have also failed to set a timeline for a second round since the first meeting last month. (현지에서 미국 정부와 의회 등을 상대하는 대사가 귀국해 현안을 논의하는 일은 이례적이다. 2025년 11월 한·미 정상이 합의한 안보 협상이나 대미 투자, 조선 협력 등이 지지부진하고, 쿠팡 사태와 정보통신망법 시행 등으로 미국과의 긴장이 높아진 상황이 배경으로 지목된다. 우라늄 농축과 사용후핵연료 재처리 권한 확대, 핵잠수함 건조 관련 협상도 지난달 첫 회의 뒤 2차 협상 시한을 못 잡고 있다.)

Separate from the sources of South Korea-US friction, discussions are expected to take place regarding US President Donald Trump's proposal at the Group of Seven (G7) summit to President Lee Jae-myung about whether South Korea could build 10 US warships. The government believes that, as multiple agencies are involved in South Korea-US negotiations, it can share the US position through Ambassador Kang and then seek solutions. Ambassador Kang is set to return on the 15th, meet Foreign Minister Cho Hyun, and then hold talks with officials from the National Security Office, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy (responsible for US investment), the Ministry of National Defense (which handles the wartime operational control transition issue), and the Ministry of Science and ICT. (한-미 갈등 요소와 별개로 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의에서 이재명 대통령에게 미국 군함 10척을 한국이 건조해 줄 수 있느냐고 제안한 것에 관한 논의도 이뤄질 것으로 보인다. 정부는 여러 부처가 한-미 협상에 관여하고 있는 만큼, 강 대사를 통해 미국 입장을 공유한 뒤 해법을 찾겠다는 생각이다. 강 대사는 15일 귀국해 조현 외교부 장관을 만난 뒤 국가안보실을 비롯해 대미 투자를 담당하는 산업통상부, 전시작전통제권 전환 현안을 가진 국방부, 과학기술정보통신부 당국자들을 만날 예정이다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "Tax Normalization, Not Housing Prices… Reforms Fail If They Are Too Noisy" (이 대통령 “집값보다 조세 정상화…개혁은 요란하면 실패”)
item.description:
Ahead of the real estate grand debate scheduled for the 23rd, President Lee Jae-myung emphasized equity in real estate taxation, stating, "We are not taxing to curb housing prices." He also stressed the importance of persuasion and consensus in the reform process, saying, "If you shout loudly and make a lot of noise, it's difficult to achieve results." (이재명 대통령이 오는 23일 부동산 대토론회를 앞두고 “집값을 잡으려고 세금을 하는 것 아니다”라며 부동산 세제 형평성을 강조했다. 이 대통령은 또 “소리를 많이 지르고 요란하게 하면 성과를 내기 어렵다”며 개혁 추진 과정에서의 설득과 공감을 강조했다.)

During a cabinet meeting presided over by the President at the Blue House on the 14th, Lee noted, "The tax system in the housing sector has become highly distorted and deformed. With too many deductions and exemptions, it has been so heavily modified that it no longer serves its basic functions. As a result, it has even become a factor stimulating real estate speculation, making normalization necessary." He added, "Suppressing housing prices is not the primary goal; 'normalization' is the first objective, and the second is to mitigate the side effects that foster speculation. I hope people understand this. 'Equitable taxation' is most important, while housing price stabilization is a secondary effect." This is interpreted as an intention to overhaul real estate taxation not as a tool for price stabilization but from the perspective of restoring tax equity and normalizing the tax system. (이 대통령은 14일 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 “지금 주택 분야에서 조세제도가 많이 왜곡되고, 변형돼 있다”며 “뭐 이렇게 공제해주고, 저렇게 빼주고 해서 너무 많이 변형해서 조세의 기본적 기능을 못 하고 있다. 그러다 보니 오히려 부동산 투기 유발 요인이 돼버려 정상화가 필요하다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 그러면서 “집값을 눌러보겠다는 게 1차 목표는 아니고 ‘정상화’가 1차 목표고, 두번째는 부수적인 투기 유발 부작용을 좀 완화해야겠다는 점을 좀 이해해주면 좋겠다”며 “‘형평성 있는 조세’가 제일 중요하고 집값 안정은 부수적 효과”라고 말했다. 부동산 세제를 집값 안정 수단이 아니라 조세 형평성 회복과 세제 정상화 관점에서 손질하겠다는 뜻을 밝힌 것으로 풀이된다.)

During the cabinet meeting, which was live-streamed on YouTube, President Lee conducted an "instant poll" via comments, asking whether there should be additional holding taxes for ultra-high-value single-home owners. Midway through the meeting, he spontaneously proposed, "To the citizens watching, if you own a single residence for actual living but agree with imposing additional holding burdens on ultra-high-value homes, please write '1' in the comments; if not, write '2'." He then spent a minute reviewing the comments streaming on the live broadcast. Director of the Office for Government Policy Coordination, Im Ki-geun, reported, "About 90% of comments were in favor of the additional burden, while about 10% were against." (이 대통령은 유튜브로 생중계되는 국무회의에서 초고가 1주택 추가 보유세 부담 여부를 댓글로 묻는 ‘즉석투표’를 하기도 했다. 이 대통령은 회의 도중 “방송 보시는 국민 여러분 중에 실거주 1주택인데, 초고가 주택에 대해선 통상적인 보호보다는 추가 보유 부담을 하는 데 동의하면 1번, 아니면 2번을 (댓글로) 써달라”고 즉석 제안한 뒤 1분간 국무회의 생중계에 달리는 댓글을 살폈다. 임기근 국무조정실장은 “추가 부담에 찬성하는 의견이 약 90%, 반대가 약 10%였다”고 말했다.)

President Lee further suggested, "What if we set a threshold for the additional burden, like 2 billion, 3 billion, or 4 billion won? Let's see which gets the most votes." When Director Im noted "3 billion won (received the most support)," Lee responded, "Unexpected; I thought it would be 5 billion." The government plans to hold open discussions on supply, finance, and taxation from today, followed by a 'National Grand Debate on Real Estate Policy' on the 23rd, which President Lee will attend. (이 대통령은 또 “얼마 이상부터 추가 부담을 부과할지 20억, 30억, 40억원 앞글자를 눌러보시면 어떻겠나 싶다”고 말했다. 임 실장이 “30억이 (제일 많다)”고 하자 이 대통령은 “의외네, 50억은 할 줄 알았는데”라고 답했다. 정부는 이날부터 공급·금융·세제를 주제로 공개 토론을 진행한 뒤 23일 이 대통령이 참석하는 ‘부동산 정책 국민 대토론회’를 열 예정이다.)

President Lee also actively countered criticisms that the government focuses solely on growth, neglecting reform and welfare. (이 대통령은 정부가 성장에만 치중해 개혁과 복지를 소홀히 한다는 일각의 지적도 적극 반박했다.)

"Recently, there seems to be talk that the Lee Jae-myung administration is too focused on growth and the economy, neglecting reform and turning its back on welfare," Lee said. "But we are continuously expanding welfare policies as needed." He likened reform to an injection, explaining, "Shouting loudly and making a fuss might seem impressive, but it strengthens resistance and makes it hard to achieve results." He continued, "I once had hives and went to a pharmacy run by a senior. Just as the needle was about to go in, I tensed up from fear, and the syringe broke. Reform is similar. We need to persuade, minimize pain, gain consensus on legitimacy from many people, and proceed step by step effectively, so that at some point, people realize things have changed." (이 대통령은 “최근 개혁과 관련해 이재명 정부가 너무 성장과 경제 얘기만 한다, 개혁을 소홀히 하는 거 아니냐, 복지를 외면하는 거 아니냐는 얘기를 하는 거 같다”며 “복지 정책은 필요한 만큼 계속 확장해 나가고 있다”고 말했다. 이어 “소리를 많이 지르고, 요란하게 하면 멋있을지는 몰라도 그렇게 하면 저항 강도가 세지고 성과를 내기가 어렵다”며 개혁을 ‘주사’에 빗대 설명하기도 했다. 이 대통령은 “과거 제가 두드러기가 올라와 선배가 있는 약국에 갔다. 주사를 탁 찌르려는 순간에 겁이 나서 힘을 줬더니 주사기가 부러졌다”며 “개혁도 비슷하다. 설득하고, 고통을 최소화하고, 정당성에 대해 많은 사람들의 공감을 얻고 순차적으로 실효적으로 해서 ‘어느 순간 보니까 바뀌었네’ 이렇게 해야 한다”고 말했다.)

While President Lee's remarks on that day were made in the context of emphasizing that social reforms are not being neglected, some interpreted them as a reference to the conflict within the Democratic Party over the abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation rights. A ruling party official commented, "I think the point is that instead of labeling those with different opinions as anti-reform over the abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation rights, we should gather various views and move forward." (이 대통령의 이날 발언은 사회개혁도 소홀히 하지 않는다는 점을 강조하는 맥락에서 나왔지만, 더불어민주당 내 검찰 보완수사권 폐지 갈등을 지적한 것이라는 해석도 나왔다. 한 여권 관계자는 “검찰 보완수사권 폐지 여부를 두고 자기 의견과 다르다고 반개혁적이라고 몰아붙일 게 아니라 서로 의견을 수렴해서 추진해야 한다는 취지의 (말씀) 아니겠냐”라고 말했다.)

Regarding Mifepristone, an abortion pill not legally available in South Korea, President Lee stated, "The government's current neglect is irresponsible. Even before alternative legislation is prepared, there could be ways to allow doctors to use their discretion in prescribing it," and instructed relevant ministries to discuss the matter. (이 대통령은 국내에선 합법적으로 구할 수 없는 먹는 임신중단약 미프진에 대해 “정부가 지금처럼 방치하는 것은 무책임하다”며 “대체 입법이 마련되기 전이라도 의사가 재량으로 처방 여부를 판단하도록 하는 방법도 있을 것 같다”며 관련 부처 협의를 지시했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji: yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "The age threshold for juvenile offenders should indeed be lowered… Let's discuss it once more" (이 대통령 “촉법소년 연령 기준, 낮추긴 낮춰야…또 한번 토론하자”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 14th that regarding the issue of lowering the age of criminal minors (juvenile offenders), "it should indeed be lowered," but he withheld a final decision at the Cabinet meeting. (이재명 대통령은 14일 형사미성년자(촉법소년) 연령 하향 문제에 관해 “낮추긴 낮춰야 한다”면서도 국무회의 최종 결정은 유보했다.)

At the Cabinet meeting held at the presidential office that day, after receiving a report from Minister of Gender Equality and Family Won Min-kyung on the results of a public discussion on lowering the age threshold for juvenile offenders, President Lee said, "Let's discuss once more whether to lower it partially, fully, for all crimes, by one year, or by two years, and also conduct public opinion surveys to gather citizens' views. It's a difficult topic, so let's not make a final decision today." Juvenile offenders refer to criminal minors aged 10 to 14 who, despite committing crimes, are exempt from criminal punishment. <<> Based on the public discussion results at the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family meeting, a plan was proposed to lower the age threshold for juvenile offenders to 'ages 10 to under 13'—a one-year reduction—but only for violent, serious, and repeat offenses. This comes four months after President Lee ordered a public discussion on lowering the juvenile offender age threshold at a Cabinet meeting in February. <<> President Lee said, "(Looking at media reports), there are cases where they say, 'I'm a juvenile offender, so I won't be punished,' and then commit crimes. When you see that, you wonder if a one-year reduction is enough. Can't a 12-year-old knowingly commit murder or a serious crime?" He added, "The Ministry of Gender Equality's opinion is not to lower it uniformly but only partially for specific crimes by one year—doesn't that seem too, too weak? Globally, isn't it quite common to set the juvenile offender age at 12?" This is interpreted as suggesting that the extent of lowering the juvenile offender age should be greater than the ministry's proposal, or that a uniform reduction should be considered. President Lee added, "The maximum reduction seems to be two years." <<> President Lee also mentioned that even juvenile offenders can be sent to juvenile detention centers for up to two years, saying, "It's not that juvenile offenders are completely unpunished currently. Some people think they face no punishment at all, so we'll listen to opinions once more." <<> By reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 원민경 성평등가족부 장관에게 촉법소년 연령 기준 하향 공론화 결과를 보고받은 뒤 “부분적으로 낮출 거냐, 전면적으로 낮출 거냐, 모든 범죄에 낮출 거냐, 1년 낮출 거냐, 2년 낮출 거냐 등에 대해 또 한번 토론해보고 여론조사 등 국민 의견 수렴도 해보자”며 “어려운 주제인데 오늘 최종 결정하지 말자”고 말했다. 촉법소년은 범죄를 저질렀지만 형사처벌은 면제받는 ‘만 10살 이상 14살 미만’의 형사미성년자를 뜻한다.)

item.title: Democratic Party’s plan for a direct election of a youth supreme council member fails due to opposition from Pro-Chung faction… backlash grows over “collective self-serving politics” (친청계 반대에 민주 ‘직선 청년 최고위원’ 무산…“집단적 자기정치” 반발 확산)
item.description:
The Supreme Council of the Democratic Party of Korea voted down the "plan to separately elect a youth supreme council member" on the 14th, sparking internal criticism. (더불어민주당 최고위원회가 14일 ‘청년최고위원 분리 선출안’을 부결시킨 것을 두고 당내 비판이 쏟아졌다.)

Kim Min-seok, a former prime minister running in the party leadership election, wrote on X (formerly Twitter) that day, "It is regrettable that the introduction of a youth supreme council member, which would broaden the path for youth politics, was thwarted by opposition from a specific candidate’s camp," and criticized it as "collective self-serving politics that prioritized small gains over the greater good." Lawmaker Song Young-gil also pointed out, "The self-serving politics of certain supreme council members have been disrupting the party convention, and now they’ve swallowed up even the youth’s place." Lawmaker Ko Min-jung noted, "How can we explain to the people that we trampled on our own proposed alternative for the sake of factional infighting and a handful of power?" Kim Yong, a former deputy director of the Democratic Party Research Institute running for the supreme council, also expressed regret, saying, "They erased the space to build a new pillar to protect their own bowls." (당대표 선거에 출마한 김민석 전 국무총리는 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 “청년 정치의 길을 넓히는 청년최고위원 도입이 특정 후보 측 반대로 무산되어 아쉽다”며 “대의보다 작은 이익을 앞세운 집단적 자기 정치”라고 비판했다. 송영길 의원도 “특정 최고위원들의 자기 정치가 전당대회를 어지럽히더니, 끝내 청년의 자리까지 집어삼켰다”고 꼬집었다. 고민정 의원은 “계파 간 다툼, 한줌 권력을 위해 우리 스스로 제시한 대안을 걷어찬 것에 대해 국민들께 무슨 말씀을 드릴 수 있겠느냐”고 지적했다. 최고위원 후보로 나선 김용 전 민주연구원 부원장도 “제 밥그릇 지키겠다고 새 기둥 세울 자리를 지워버렸다”고 아쉬움을 표했다.)

Earlier, on the 9th, the party’s convention preparation committee (CPC) decided to separate one of the five elected supreme council members as a youth seat and reported the agenda to the Supreme Council. However, during the Supreme Council meeting that day, figures classified as the Pro-Chung (Chung Cheong-rae) faction voted against it, leading to its rejection. While former Prime Minister Kim and Lawmaker Song had pledged to institutionalize the elected youth supreme council member system, former representative Chung Cheong-rae had stated he would appoint one of the two supreme council members nominated by the party leader as a youth member. On that day as well, Chung expressed his position, saying, "The youth supreme council member system lacks relevant party constitution and rules," and "Without any legal basis, even if the CPC resolves it, it’s not a valid resolution." Around the party, there are many assessments that the Pro-Chung faction lacks suitable candidates to put forward as youth supreme council members. (앞서 지난 9일 민주당 전당대회준비위원회(전준위)는 선출직 최고위원 5명 가운데 1명을 청년 몫으로 분리 선출하기로 결정하고 해당 안건을 최고위에 보고했으나, 이날 최고위 회의에서 친청(정청래)계로 분류되는 인사들이 반대표를 던져 부결시켰다. 김 전 총리와 송 의원은 선출직 청년최고위원제의 제도화를 공약한 반면, 정청래 전 대표는 당대표가 지명하는 최고위원 2명 중 1명을 청년으로 임명하겠다고 밝힌 바 있다. 정 전 대표는 이날에도 “청년최고위원제는 (관련한) 당헌·당규가 없다”며 “근거 조항이 없는데 전준위에서 의결한들 의결한 게 아니다”라는 입장을 밝혔다. 당 주변에서는 친청계에서 청년최고위원 후보로 내세울 인물이 마땅치 않다는 평이 많다.)

Criticism also erupted from within the party’s youth organization. Lawmaker Mo Kyung-jong, the chairman of the Democratic Party’s National Youth Committee and a CPC member, met with reporters that day and stated, "It’s regrettable that the CPC’s decision was not respected by the Supreme Council," and added, "I hope the new leadership will amend the party constitution as quickly as possible to address the situation where the youth supreme council member system was not implemented due to a lack of time for preparation." Bong Geon-woo, chairman of the Democratic Party’s National University Student Committee, held a press conference at the National Assembly that day and announced his resignation from the party’s election management committee, saying, "This was supposed to be the starting point for change to restore youth sentiment, but it ultimately fell through." (당내 청년 조직에서도 비판이 터져나왔다. 민주당 전국청년위원장이자 전준위 위원인 모경종 의원은 이날 기자들을 만나 “전준위 의결을 최고위에서 존중받지 못해서 유감”이라며 “시기상 (준비 시간이) 부족하다는 이유로 청년최고위원제가 도입되지 못한 상황을 보완하기 위한 당헌 개정을 새 지도부에서 최대한 빨리 해주길 바란다”고 말했다. 봉건우 민주당 전국대학생위원장은 이날 국회에서 기자회견을 열어 “청년 민심 회복을 위한 변화의 출발점이었는데 끝내 무산됐다”며 당 선거관리위원에서 사퇴한다고 밝혔다.)

Reporter Ko Kyung-ju goh@hani.co.kr (고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party Decides to Introduce ‘Preferential Voting System’ for Party Leader Election…‘Opponent’ Jeong Cheong-rae Says “I Accept” (민주, 당대표 선거에 ‘선호투표제’ 도입키로…‘반대’ 정청래 “수용한다”)
item.description:
The leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea decided on the 14th to introduce a preferential voting system for the election of the party leader at the August 17 national convention. This marks the conclusion of the rules after a week of turmoil following the decision by the National Convention Preparation Committee on the 7th to adopt the system. (더불어민주당 지도부가 8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거에 선호투표제를 도입하기로 14일 결정했다. 지난 7일 전당대회준비위원회가 도입을 결정한 뒤 일주일간의 진통 끝에 규칙을 일단 매듭지은 것이다.)

Senior Spokesperson Kang Jun-hyeon announced the decision to introduce the preferential voting system during a briefing after a closed-door Supreme Council meeting on the morning of the same day, stating, “Ahead of the national convention, we have decided to amend the party rules to minimize controversy over violations related to the election of the leadership.” He added, “We have decided to stipulate in the party rules that either the preferential voting system or a runoff voting system can be used as a method for conducting a runoff election.” During this process, Supreme Council member Lee Seong-yoon, a close ally of Jeong Cheong-rae, resigned from his post in protest. The preferential voting system is a method used when three or more candidates are running and no candidate secures a majority of votes. In such cases, the lowest-ranked candidate is eliminated, and their second-preference votes are added to the totals of the top two candidates, determining the final winner on the same day. (강준현 수석대변인은 이날 오전 비공개 최고위원회 뒤 브리핑에서 선호투표제 도입 결정을 발표하며 “전당대회를 앞두고 지도부 선출과 관련해 규정 (위반) 논란을 최소화하기 위해 당규를 개정하기로 했다”며 “(당규에) 결선투표 실시 방법으로 선호투표제와 결선투표제를 할 수 있음을 명문화하기로 했다”고 말했다. 이 과정에서 친정청래계인 이성윤 최고위원은 반발해 직을 사퇴했다. 선호투표제는 3명 이상의 후보자가 출마했을 때 과반 득표자가 안 나올 경우 최하위 득표자를 탈락시킨 뒤 그가 얻은 2순위 표를 1·2위 후보에게 합산해 당일 최종 당선자를 결정하는 방식이다.)

Article 66 of the Democratic Party’s rules states: ‘The party leader election shall have a candidate with a majority of votes as the winner. Specific methods for conducting a runoff election for this purpose shall be determined by the National Convention Preparation Committee and finalized through approval by the Supreme Council and the Party Affairs Committee.’ This clause has been amended to read: ‘If there are three or more candidates in the primary, either the preferential voting system or a runoff voting system shall be chosen and implemented to determine a majority vote winner.’ Former leader Jeong Cheong-rae’s faction had previously objected, arguing that the preferential voting system, which is not specified in the party constitution or rules, has potential for violating them. (민주당 당규 66조엔 ‘당 대표 선거는 과반수 득표자를 당선인으로 한다. 이를 위한 결선투표 실시의 구체적 방식은 전당대회준비위원회에서 정하고 최고위와 당무위원회 의결로 확정한다’고 돼 있는데 이 조항을 “경선 후보자가 3인 이상이면 과반수 득표자 결정을 위해 선호투표 또는 결선투표 중 하나를 정해 실시한다”로 바꾼 것이다. 정청래 전 대표 쪽은 그동안 당헌·당규에 명시되지 않은 선호투표제는 당헌·당규 위반 소지가 있다고 반발해왔다.)

After the Supreme Council’s decision, major contenders for the party leadership announced their acceptance. Former leader Jeong wrote on Facebook that day, “I coolly accept the party’s decision.” He later told reporters at the National Assembly, “If a lawsuit is filed later, the (convention) results could be invalidated, so I demanded that the possibility of violating the party constitution and rules be resolved.” Former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and lawmaker Song Young-gil also responded, respectively: “It’s better not to have candidates arguing over the rules,” and “It has been well organized, as I have consistently argued.” (최고위 결정 뒤 주요 당권 주자들은 수용하겠다는 뜻을 밝혔다. 정 전 대표는 이날 페이스북에 “당의 결정을 쿨하게 수용한다”고 썼다. 그는 이후 국회에서 기자들에게 “나중에 소송이 걸리면 (전대 결과가) 무효가 될 수 있기 때문에 당헌·당규 위반 소지를 해소해달라고 요구한 것”이라고 말했다. 김민석 전 총리와 송영길 의원도 각각 “룰을 갖고 선수들은 이야기 안 하는 게 좋다”, “제가 일관되게 주장했던 대로 잘 정리됐다”고 반응했다.)

It is known that Acting Leader and Floor Leader Han Byeong-do, who also serves as the party’s representative, has been persuading opponents like former leader Jeong behind the scenes to finalize the introduction of the preferential voting system before the two-day candidate registration period (August 16-17) for the upcoming convention begins. In this process, former leader Jeong indicated on the 13th, “If the issue of violating the party constitution and rules is resolved, I will follow whatever decision is made,” signaling acceptance on the condition of amending the party rules. Former leader Jeong was also under pressure to avoid disruptions to the convention schedule due to his opposition. After the decision on the preferential voting system, he said, “The national convention is imminent, and continued chaos could lead to various side effects, so I respect and accept it for the greater good.” Additionally, it is known that former leader Jeong’s faction views the preferential voting and runoff voting systems as unlikely to overturn the election outcome. (한병도 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 이틀 앞으로 다가온 전당대회 후보등록(16∼17일) 시작 전에 선호투표제 도입을 마무리하려 이에 반발하는 정 전 대표 등을 물밑 설득해온 것으로 알려졌다. 이 과정에서 정 전 대표는 지난 13일 “당헌·당규 (위반) 문제가 해소되면 어떤 결정을 하든 따르겠다”며 당규 개정을 전제로 한 수용 의사를 표시했다. 정 전 대표로서는 자신의 반대 탓에 전대 일정에 차질이 생기는 데 대한 부담도 없지 않았다. 그는 선호투표제 결정 뒤 “전당대회가 코앞에 있고 혼란이 계속되면 여러 부작용이 있기 때문에 대승적 차원에서 존중하고 수용한다”고 했다. 아울러 정 전 대표 쪽은 선호투표와 결선투표가 승패 결과를 뒤바꿀 만한 변수는 아니라고 보는 것으로 알려졌다.)

Meanwhile, the introduction of a system to elect a youth supreme council member by separating one of the five elected supreme council seats was rejected after a vote in the Supreme Council. It was understood that Supreme Council members Park Gyu-hwan, Moon Jung-bok, and Park Ji-won, who are aligned with the pro-Jeong faction, led the rejection. A first-term lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area commented to the Hankyoreh, “It seems former leader Jeong’s faction placed importance on being able to form a majority Supreme Council (which would exclude an unfriendly youth supreme council member if he is elected party leader).” (한편, 선출직 최고위원 5명 가운데 1명을 청년최고위원으로 분리해 뽑는 선출직 청년최고위원제 도입은 최고위원회 표결 끝에 부결됐다. 친청계 최고위원인 박규환, 문정복, 박지원 최고위원 등이 부결을 이끈 것으로 파악됐다. 한 수도권 초선 의원은 한겨레에 “정 전 대표 쪽은 (자신이 당대표에 당선됐을 때 비우호적인 청년최고위원이 포함되지 않은) 과반 최고위를 구성할 수 있을지를 중요하게 본 것 같다”고 평했다.)

Reporter Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr Reporter Go Kyeong-ju goh@hani.co.kr (최하얀 기자 chy@hani.co.kr 김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr 고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Need to Retain Some Supplementary Investigation Powers" – Cautious Approach Emerges at DP Assembly…"Debate Continues" (“보완수사권 일부 존치 필요” 신중론 나온 민주 의총…“토론 계속”)
item.description:
At the Democratic Party of Korea's general meeting of lawmakers held on the 14th, a cautious stance was raised that supplementary investigation powers should be retained on an exceptional basis, amid the debate over abolishing prosecutors' supplementary investigative authority. The 'Gwangju high school student murder case' appears to have influenced public criticism of the complete abolition of these powers, adding pressure. <<> Kim Han-kyu, senior deputy chief of policy coordination at the party, reported on the revision of the Criminal Procedure Act proposed by the party's task force on the 9th during the National Assembly lawmakers' meeting. The bill's core is to completely abolish prosecutors' supplementary investigation powers while controlling police abuse of investigative authority. After the report, Rep. Hong Ki-won took the podium to explain his own proposed amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act. This bill includes provisions to maintain supplementary investigation powers for crimes targeting socially vulnerable groups and crimes infringing on public welfare. Eleven lawmakers, including Hong Ki-won, Ko Min-jeong, Kwak Sang-eon, Kim Nam-hee, Mo Gyeong-jong, Moon Jin-seok, Min Hong-cheol, Park Gyun-taek, Park Hee-seung, Lee So-young, and Ju Cheol-hyeon, have signed onto the bill. <<> Over the two-hour meeting, 15 lawmakers spoke. Among them, 10, including Reps. Hong Ki-won, Park Gyun-taek, and Lee So-young, expressed that the complete abolition of supplementary investigation powers should be approached cautiously, considering side effects. Rep. Ko Min-jeong also told reporters, "There are concerns from some quarters that (the abolition of supplementary investigation powers) may leave gaps in investigations of sexual violence, child abuse, and cases involving persons with disabilities. We should implement the abolition only when it becomes clear how to address those issues." Reps. Kim Dong-ah and Lee Sang-sik reportedly suggested that even if the powers are abolished, measures could include allowing prosecutors to be involved in investigations from the start or granting them authority to verify facts to mitigate side effects. <<> Voices also called for a swift decision to completely abolish supplementary investigation powers. <<> Rep. Kim Yong-min, who jointly proposed a bill to abolish supplementary investigation powers with Rep. Park Eun-jeong of the Fatherland Innovation Party on the 26th of last month, reportedly said, "A political decision is needed to abolish supplementary investigation powers." After the meeting, he held a press conference and criticized, "According to Rep. Hong Ki-won's (proposed amendment), it would make possible targeted investigations by prosecutors and an unlimited expansion of investigative authority." <<> After the meeting, Deputy Spokesperson Lee Joo-hee told reporters, "There doesn't seem to be any opinion within the party to fully retain supplementary investigation powers," adding, "There were a few opinions on whether to allow some powers on an exceptional and limited basis. Lawmakers particularly gave much thought to the issue of socially vulnerable groups." <<> Party leadership contender Chung Cheong-rae, a former party leader, shared on Facebook an article reporting that 10 lawmakers had indicated a cautious stance on abolishing supplementary investigation powers at the meeting, writing, "This is really serious. I feel depressed about why this atmosphere has suddenly emerged." <<> The Democratic Party plans to invite experts next week to hold a policy meeting of lawmakers and continue the discussion. Floor Leader Park Chan-dae said in his opening remarks at the meeting, "We must complete the last piece of prosecutorial reform by amending the Criminal Procedure Act to completely abolish supplementary investigation powers," and added, "I hope we can finalize a criminal justice system for the people through sufficient deliberation and intense debate." <<> Jeong Hye-min, Kim Chae-woon, Jo Hee-yeon, and Choi Ha-yan, reporters jhm@hani.co.kr (검사 보완수사권 폐지 문제를 두고 14일 열린 더불어민주당 의원총회에서 예외적으로 보완수사권을 유지해야 한다는 ‘신중론’이 제기됐다. ‘광주 고교생 살해사건’을 계기로 보완수사권 전면 폐지에 대한 비판 여론이 영향을 미친 것으로 보인다.)

item.title: Song Young-gil criticizes Chung Cheong-rae, saying “It feels like looking down on the president” and uses “abortion” in his critique (송영길, 정청래에 “대통령 깔보는 느낌”…“낙태” 써가며 비판)
item.description:
Song Young-gil, a lawmaker from the Democratic Party of Korea, criticized former representative Chung Cheong-rae’s remarks about regretting the nomination in Pyeongtaek-eul, calling them “extremely irresponsible” and stating, “It’s like saying to your son, ‘I should have aborted you, but I gave birth to you instead.’” (송영길 더불어민주당 의원은 정청래 전 대표의 ‘평택을 공천 후회’ 취지의 발언에 대해 “너무 무책임하다”며 “예를 들어서 자기 아들한테 ‘내가 너 낙태했어야 되는데 낳아서’ 그런 거하고 똑같은 것”이라고 말했다.)

Appearing on MBC Radio’s “Kim Jong-bae’s Focus” on the 15th, Song reignited the issue of responsibility for the local elections, saying, “By absorbing every issue into the Pyeongtaek election, we lost all the clear strengths we had in this local election.” Even after the host noted that the “abortion” analogy was inappropriate, Song insisted, “It’s exactly the same. What about the party members who supported Kim Yong-nam (the Democratic Party candidate at the time) as the regional committee chair?” (송 의원은 15일 문화방송(MBC) 라디오 ‘김종배의 시선집중’에 출연해 “모든 이슈를 평택 선거가 빨아들임으로써 이번 지방선거에서 선명한 우리 강점의 이슈를 다 놓쳐버렸다”며 지방선거 책임론을 다시 꺼냈다. 특히 송 의원은 ‘낙태’ 발언에 대해 진행자가 “비유가 좀 그렇다”고 지적했음에도 “그런 거하고 똑같은 거다. 당시 (더불어민주당 후보였던) 김용남 지역위원장을 지지한 당원들은 어떻게 되는 거냐”고 했다.)

Song also said, “Former representative Chung Cheong-rae and I became lawmakers before President Lee Jae-myung. Since we entered politics earlier, there’s a feeling that (Chung) is somewhat looking down on the president.” (송 의원은 또 “정청래 전 대표나 저나 이재명 대통령보다 먼저 국회의원이 됐고, 정치로서는 먼저 되다 보니까 (정 전 대표가) 뭔가 대통령을 약간 깔본다고 그럴까 하는 느낌이 있다”고 말했다.)

Earlier, on the previous day, Chung appeared on YouTube’s “Kim Eo-joon’s News Factory” and expressed regret over the Democratic Party fielding a candidate in the by-election for the Pyeongtaek-eul National Assembly seat, which was contested by Cho Kuk, leader of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, saying, “I often think about how it might have been if the merger with the Cho Kuk Innovation Party had succeeded before the local elections.” (앞서, 정 전 대표는 전날 유튜브 ‘김어준의 뉴스공장’ 에 출연해 “지방선거 전에 (조국혁신당과의) 합당이 성공했으면 어땠을까 하는 생각도 많이 하게 된다”며 당시 조국 조국혁신당 대표가 출마한 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에 민주당 후보를 낸 것을 후회한다는 취지의 발언을 했다.)

Park Ji-won (five-term lawmaker) of the Democratic Party appeared on YTN’s “Jang Sung-chul’s News Myeongdang” on the same day and said, “I think it’s possible to have regrets. But even if you feel that way inside, I think that’s something you shouldn’t express.” (박지원(5선) 민주당 의원은 이날 와이티엔(YTN) ‘장성철의 뉴스명당’에 출연해 “후회할 수 있다고 본다. 하지만 마음 속으로 (후회를) 하더라도 그 표현을 해서는 안 되는 내용이라고 본다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party "Will Push for Hearing on Homeplus Crisis… MBK and Meritz Only Focus on Evading Responsibility" (민주당 “홈플러스 사태 청문회 추진…MBK·메리츠, 책임 회피만 골몰”)
item.description:
Han Byeong-do, acting leader and floor leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, stated on the 15th, "The Democratic Party will push for a hearing on the Homeplus crisis." (한병도 더불어민주당 당대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 15일 “민주당은 홈플러스 사태 청문회를 추진하겠다”라고 밝혔다.)

During a Supreme Council meeting at the National Assembly that morning, Acting Leader Han said, "The Homeplus crisis is causing enormous damage to 13,000 workers and their families, as well as to tenant and supplier companies, and further to local communities, consumers, and the people," adding, "Even though bankruptcy proceedings are imminent, MBK and Meritz remain passive and solely focused on evading responsibility." (한 직무대행은 이날 오전 국회 최고위원회의에서 “(홈플러스 사태로) 1만3천여명의 노동자와 그 가족, 입점 업체와 납품 업체, 나아가 지역사회와 소비자, 국민에게도 막대한 피해가 돌아간다”며 “파산 절차가 코앞으로 다가왔음에도 불구하고, 엠비케이(MBK)와 메리츠는 여전히 소극적인 태도로 책임 회피에만 골몰하고 있다”라고 말했다.)

He continued, "Yesterday, I instructed Park Sang-hyuk, the secretary of the Political Affairs Committee, to immediately hold a hearing to thoroughly investigate the truth of this incident," emphasizing, "The Democratic Party will do its utmost to uncover the truth, punish those responsible, and protect workers' livelihoods, support related businesses, and safeguard local economies." (이어 “저는 어제 박상혁 정무위 간사에게 즉각 청문회를 개최하여 이번 사태의 진상을 낱낱이 규명할 것을 지시했다”면서 “민주당은 진상 규명과 책임자 처벌, 나아가 노동자의 생존권 사수와 관련 업체의 지원, 지역 경제 보호에도 끝까지 노력을 다하겠다”라고 강조했다.)

Turning to the People Power Party, he urged, "In the first half of the 22nd National Assembly, they defended the Yoon Seok-yeol insurrection and paralyzed the Assembly with indiscriminate filibustering. In the second half, they have even refused to form the Assembly's leadership, bringing its operations to a halt," demanding, "Cooperate immediately in forming the Assembly's leadership." (또 국민의힘을 향해서는 “22대 국회 전반기에는 윤석열 내란을 옹호하고, 무차별적인 필리버스터로 국회를 마비시키더니, 후반기에는 원 구성조차 거부하며 국회 운영을 멈춰 세웠다”며 “즉시 원 구성에 협조하라”라고 촉구했다.)

Senior Spokesperson Kang Jun-hyun told reporters after the Supreme Council meeting, "We intend to proceed even if the People Power Party does not attend." He stated that a hearing is planned for the 27th. (강준현 수석대변인은 최고위원회 뒤 기자와 만나 “국민의힘이 참석하지 않더라도 추진하려 한다”고 밝혔다. 강 수석대변인은 오는 27일 청문회 개최를 계획하고 있다고 전했다.)

Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr Reporter Go Gyeong-ju goh@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr 고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Lee Jae-oh: "Jang Dong-hyuk's 'Take It or Leave It' Attitude Is Like a Gangster... He Should Quit Not Just as Party Leader but as a Lawmaker" (이재오 “장동혁 ‘배 째라’는 건달이나…대표 아니라 의원도 그만둬야”)
item.description:
Lee Jae-oh, senior adviser to the People Power Party (PPP), said of PPP leader Jang Dong-hyuk, "He shouldn't just step down as party leader—he should resign as a member of the National Assembly." He argued that after the June 3 local elections, "It's unthinkable to lose and still stubbornly say, 'Take it or leave it.'" (이재오 국민의힘 상임고문이 장동혁 국민의힘 대표를 향해 “대표만 그만두는 게 아니라 국회의원을 던져야 된다”고 말했다. 6·3 지방선거 뒤 “져놓고도 ‘배 째라’라고 버티는 건 있을 수도 없는 일”이라는 것이다.)

Lee, who serves as chairman of the Korea Democracy Foundation, appeared on CBS Radio's "Park Jae-hong's One-Round Show" on the 14th and stated, "In politics, whether you're the ruling party or the opposition, after a major election, the party leader, regardless of their term, typically says they've done their part and steps down—that's the custom." He added, "But losing and then insisting on a 'take it or leave it' attitude is something from a back alley; it's hard to even talk about." When the host asked, "Like a gangster?" Lee nodded lightly and said, "That (refusing to resign) is truly unacceptable." (민주화운동기념사업회 이사장을 맡고 있는 이 고문은 14일 시비에스(CBS) 라디오 ‘박재홍의 한판승부’에 나와 “여당이든 야당이든 큰 선거가 끝나면 당 대표였던 사람은 임기와 관계없이 내 역할을 다했으니까 그만둔다 하는 게 정치의 관례”라며 “근데 져놓고도 ‘배 째라’라고 버티는 건 뒷골목, 참 말하기 뭐하지만”이라고 했다. 진행자가 “건달?”이라고 하자 이 고문은 가볍게 고개를 끄덕인 뒤 “그거(사퇴를 안 하는 것)는 진짜 있을 수도 없는 일”이라고 했다.)

Lee noted, "If someone digs in like that with a 'take it or leave it' attitude, the party will gradually collapse." He urged, "Representative Jang, you seem a bit intoxicated now—pull yourself together and announce your resignation." He continued, "If the election has been such a disaster, I believe he should not only step down as party leader but also resign as a lawmaker. He should leave his seat in the Assembly and go back to run in his hometown election to relearn politics. That's the political leadership expected of someone who once led the party." (이 고문은 “저렇게 ‘배 째라’고 눌러앉아 있으면 당은 점점 망하는 것”이라며 “(장 대표가) 지금 뭐가 좀 취해있는데, 정신 차리고 그만두겠다 (해야 한다)”고 했다. 이어 “저렇게 이번 선거에 망했으면 대표만 그만두는 게 아니라 국회의원을 던져야 된다고 본다”며 “국회의원까지 그만두고 ‘정치를 내 고향 선거에 가서 다시 배워오겠다' 그런 자세로 다시 그만둬야 한다. 그게 한때나마 대표를 했던 사람의 정치적 리더십”이라고도 했다.)

Lee warned, "If the PPP persists like this, it will suffer a crushing defeat in the general election two years from now. The question is whether the party is dismantled now or later." He added, "To avoid dismantling and instead repair things, the leader should step down, the leadership should resign too—not just the leader, but also the supreme council members. We need to show a fresh start for the party; only then might the public consider trusting us once more." Lee concluded, "The party is now even destroying the last hope of the people." (이 고문은 “국민의힘이 저렇게 버티면 내후년 총선에 참패한다. 당을 지금 해체하느냐, 그때 해체하느냐의 차이”라며 “해체 안 하고 수선하려면 대표라도 그만두고, 우리 지도부도 물러난다, 대표뿐만 아니라 무슨 최고위원들도 그만두고 새롭게 당이 출발해야 되겠다, 이런 거라도 보여줘야 국민들이 그래도 좀 한번 믿어볼까 (한다)”고 했다. 이 고문은 “이제는 국민들 마지막 희망마저 당이 없애고 있는 것”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Regarding Jang's "disciplinary politics," Lee pointed out, "The non-mainstream within the party says 'step down' whenever they feel like it. But is it grounds for discipline just because someone says 'step down' or curses the leader?" He criticized, "What Jang Dong-hyuk is doing doesn't strengthen party discipline. It's actually a lack of discipline when the person who should leave doesn't leave. What kind of discipline is that?" (장 대표의 ‘징계 정치’와 관련해 이 고문은 “(당내) 비주류는 심심하면 ‘대표 내려오라’고 한다”며 “그런데 무슨 ‘대표 내려오라’ 그랬다고, 대표 욕한다고 (징계를 하나)”고 지적했다. 이어 “장동혁처럼 하는 게 당 기강이 안 서는 것이다. 나가야 될 사람이 안 나가고 있는 게 기강이 안 서는 것이다”라며 “무슨 기강은 기강이냐”고 비판했다.)

By Jeon Gwang-joon, light@hani.co.kr (전광준 기자 light@hani.co.kr)
